name: lumi-dsh-runtime-bridge-profile
description: LumiThink E2E-02 (issue #52) bridge worker profile: explicit Cordis allowlist for the REAL DSH runtime that the lumi-dsh-runtime-bridge BridgeAgentPort adapter drives. Zero bundles; no SDK JSON-RPC serving (the bridge is the in-process owner), no tool providers, no telemetry/session-log/crash-reporting, loopback-only model route. Must never reuse the R0 lumithink-child profile or any official default profile.
